title: Longitudinal Outcomes Observatory
build_status: Complete locally — external and owner-controlled decisions held
summary: Create twenty-four international longitudinal adjudication packets with six compatibility tests each while admitting zero series and zero observations until stable source payloads and governed decisions exist.
record_scope: Append-only Phase 194 global-reference content layer over the Phase 116–180 evidence and operating corpus.
publication_boundaries: Prepared content and evidence-control architecture only. A mapped authority, source portal, acquisition slot, question, or review packet does not establish an external fact, project stage, accepted service, compatible series, comparison result, score, rank, translation approval, expert approval, or publication decision.
An institutional home page is an authority-discovery rail, not an exact artifact and not evidence for a downstream claim.
Unknown, unavailable, not-yet-reviewed, and incompatible are preserved as distinct states; no unsuccessful search is treated as proof of nonexistence.
